## Reading it

- **loses** — measured slower than the same pipeline without the fold
  (same executor); the number is the worst module it binds.
- **unmeasured** — the fold never fires on the 7-module corpus. Nothing
  is known about its wall-clock pay; the cost model is not a measurement.

Next step, if these are ever to claim pay: measure each on its own bound
site (the mint record carries `sites`/`mods`), or mark them in the ledger
as vocabulary-only.
